gaps.jd_requirement: Experience with SaaS B2B product management
gaps.resume_weakness: Resume mentions 'product management' but doesn't specify SaaS or B2B keywords
gaps.fix_strategy: In interview: 'My product work was specifically in B2B SaaS—I managed enterprise features for 200+ customers, handling complex procurement cycles and multi-stakeholder decision processes.'

gaps.resume_weakness: Resume shows 'product manager' title but no explicit tenure stated
gaps.fix_strategy: In interview: 'I have 4.5 years of product management experience. In my current role, I grew MRR from $2M to $5.5M through feature prioritization and GTM strategy.'

role_content_refined: Define product vision and roadmap for creative tools
Conduct user research and validate hypotheses
Collaborate with design and engineering on feature development

offer_strategy.script: Based on my 4.5 years in product management where I grew MRR from $2M to $5.5M and shipped features adopted by 85% of enterprise customers, and given market data showing PMs at Adobe ranging $135K-$175K, I'm targeting $160K total compensation. I'm also interested in understanding career progression to Senior PM. How does that align with your budget?

questions.question: Tell me about a feature you decided NOT to build and why
questions.interviewer_intent: Testing prioritization skills and saying no to stakeholders
questions.star_blueprint: Our sales team pushed for a white-label feature. After analyzing, only 3 of 200 customers would use it, requiring 6 engineering months. I proposed a partnership model instead, preserving eng capacity for features with 40%+ adoption potential.

questions.question: How would you prioritize between fixing technical debt vs building new features?
questions.interviewer_intent: Assessing product-engineering balance and technical fluency
questions.star_blueprint: I'd quantify both: if tech debt is slowing velocity by 30% or causing customer churn, it outweighs new features. I use a framework: customer pain (high/low) × business impact (high/low) × eng effort (high/low).
questions.resume_anchor: Balanced technical debt reduction with feature velocity
